list.name: Train/Test Split & Lifecycle Markers
list.rawQuery: SELECT event_ts AS time, component || ': ' || event_type AS title, COALESCE(details::text, model_version) AS text FROM eonet_lifecycle_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) ORDER BY event_ts;

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('30 days', scored_at_utc) AS time, model_version || ' (' || data_split || ')' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(abs_error_hours)::numeric, 2) AS mae_hours FROM eonet_prediction_history WHERE actual_duration_hours IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(scored_at_utc) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Model Prediction Error (MAE Hours): Before Split (train, solid) vs. Testing Era (test, dashed)

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_version || ' [' || data_split || ']' AS model_split, ROUND(AVG(abs_error_hours)::numeric, 1) AS mae_hours, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(squared_error_hours))::numeric, 1) AS rmse_hours FROM eonet_prediction_history WHERE actual_duration_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Train vs. Test Split Error Summary (MAE & RMSE Hours)

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Tier ' || pred_severity_tier::text AS severity_tier, COUNT(*) AS count FROM eonet_predictions WHERE model_version = 'v3_xgboost' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT model_version, data_split, COUNT(*) AS evaluated_events, ROUND(AVG(pred_duration_hours)::numeric, 1) AS avg_pred_h, ROUND(AVG(actual_duration_hours)::numeric, 1) AS avg_actual_h, ROUND(AVG(abs_error_hours)::numeric, 1) AS mae_h, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(squared_error_hours))::numeric, 1) AS rmse_h FROM eonet_prediction_history GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
